goal: Product Actualizer Architect is understood, trusted and adoptable by its first buyers: grounded category and name, brand, public website with a live mechanism demo, JS-rendered voiced explainer, and a GTM kit, every public claim OBSERVED or VERIFIED

excluded.recon-physical: no hardware, CAD or media in the product; external web research is cited as REPORTED sources
excluded.embedded-systems: no firmware or microcontroller target in the product
excluded.robotics: no embodied closed loop with a physical actuator
excluded.product-visualization: no physical or 3D product form to render faithfully
excluded.legacy-modernization: the code is not being changed to launch; this run produces launch artifacts only
